{{Quote|I want a full detachment sent to the adjacent hangar|The captain to an Imperial officer|<ref name="Homecoming" />}}
An '''Imperial carrier captain''' served in during the early rebellion against the [[Galactic Empire]]. While serving as a [[captain]] for a [[Phoenix Nest|''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier]], a [[Mission to Ryloth (Phoenix Squadron)|mission]] was carried out by [[Phoenix Cell]] [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]] to capture the [[carrier]] for use by the rebel group in housing their [[rebel pilot]]s. During the infiltration on the carrier, an [[Imperial officer]] notified the captain that they lost contact with the containment [[squad]]. The captain then ordered a full detachment be sent to the adjacent [[hangar]]. This order, however, was not carried out as rebels [[Hera Syndulla]], [[Kanan Jarrus]], and [[Ezra Bridger]] barged into the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]].<ref name="Homecoming" />

The Imperial captain tried to shoot Kanan Jarrus, but was deflected by his [[lightsaber]]. He then informed the rebels that reinforcements were on their way, only for Hera to thank him for the notification. Kanan then let Ezra use a [[mind trick]] on the officer to tell the crew of the carrier to abandon ship. Ezra then told the captain to also abandon ship with the rest of the crew.<ref name="Homecoming" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial carrier captain appeared in "[[Homecoming]]," an episode in the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. He was voiced by [[Corey Burton]].<ref name="Homecoming" />
